social.text: Red herring 🎣 A red herring is a deliberate misdirection: a clue, suspect or detail that seems important but pushes the audience toward the wrong conclusion. Most common in mystery, thriller and horror. A good one is plausible, fair, and eventually explained. It should feel believable on first watch and obvious in hindsight. If it’s never resolved, it’s not a red herring. It’s a plot hole. # Filmmaking # Screenwriting # Storytelling # Misdirection # RedHerring
